notes.title: Customize your Sinner!
notes.content:
[h3]We have something really special for you. There's no point in stretching out the introductory words because we can't wait to give you another free add-on to Hell Architect!

This time we are adding a feature that will make each of your Circles of Hell unique.  From now on Your tortures can be inflicted upon... co-workers, bosses, family, and disliked exes. In general, anyone who wronged you. Without further ado, we present...[/h3]

[h2]THE MIRROR OF THE SOUL[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/d876fdac7095406b95c39067551ad2a54f9a317b.png[/img]

A brand new building and a brand new function – from now on you can [b]CUSTOMIZE YOUR SINNERS.[/b]

Thanks to the Mirror of The Soul you can change your Sinners:

Name
Skin color
Body type
Hairstyle
The method of "Censorship"
Headgear

Take and benefit from it all. There's no waiting around. Now Hell will be EXACTLY the way you want it!

Have fun, our dear f(r)iends!

notes.title: Food and Rest - The Bittersweet Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/be0e93c617b3cc223e85f5481d29e38bcc1fb7e5.png[/img]
[h3][b]Dear somber souls [/b][/h3]

First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize for being a little late with the news. This past month was a bit rough and had some of our team members sick for quite some time. Our caring nature did not allow us to release the update before making sure everything was done the way it should be.
We may have had some obstacles on our way, but today we are ready and happy to announce that the [b]NEW[/b] Bittersweet Update has just arrived! 
This is another stop on our path planned for 2022 and it brings a couple of new fun things to your Hell!
You're probably wondering what it is, right?! 
Well, well, well... 😈 

Here's [u][b]what we added: [/b][/u]

[b]*New building: Oven[/b] - Used to bake special treats for your lost souls... why not make them happy to exploit them more later?! 
[b]*New building: Wheat Farm[/b] - Well needed if you want to use the Oven 
[b]*New resource: Wheat[/b]
[b]*Pastries[/b] - Drag them onto the sinner and shove them in their mouths! 
[b]*New building: SPA[/b] - Just a little better than the Hibernation Chamber
[b]*'Ongoing Event' clock[/b]
[b]*UI Scalling[/b] 
[b]*Balance improvements[/b]

Feeding sinners and building a SPA for them in Hell sounds too good to be true?! 
Well... we couldn't help ourselves but to add a little twist to it all. Since you can now bake different pastries for your sinners, be careful which one you choose! Each pastry has its own unique effect so we suggest for you to feed your sinners wisely... you don't want them to be too happy, right?! 
Yeah... that's what we thought 😈

Dive into the world of pain, suffering and tortures now and try the new features for yourself! 🔥

notes.title: NEW Hell 2.0 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/8e8ef09555118afb16e316f02aff010a96fa23cc.png[/img]
[b][h3]Dear somber souls! [/h3][/b]
The big day everyone’s been waiting for has finally come! 
We’re aware of the fact that it may have seemed forever, but we worked extremely hard to make Hell Architect even better for you! 
For the past few months we’ve paid attention to all reviews and made sure every problem/ suggestion was passed along to our hellish team. We heard every voice and took every feedback to our hearts as you, our dear architects, are why we do what we do!
For that reason we’re happy to announce that

[h2][b]HELL 2.0 is finally here! [/b][/h2]

Great news right?! Though you’re probably wondering what has changed…

[b]Here’s what we’ve fixed so far: [/b]

* Inverted control after Scenario 6 
* Game save 
* Removal of unnecessary and unused buildings
* ‘Trial Period’ Achievement
* Hell No More achievement
* Sinners will no longer fall through dirt
* ‘Waterboarding’ animation
* ‘Yiff’ animation
* Legends’ hair no longer pop through their hats
* Building priority
* Overlays now remain active after reloading the scene
* Translation for all 12 languages
* UI
* General game optimization
* Task attribution optimization
* Overlay optimization

[b]Here’s what we’ve added: [/b]

* A few new tabs in the build menu that will help you to organize various types of decorations. The following categories of decorations are now: All, Lights, Bones, Graffiti and Other.
* ANIMATED set of HELLoween decorations
* Gothic Decoration Pack
* Quality of Life: ability to deconstruct many buildings at once by dragging the cursor over
them
* Quality of Life: ability to replace platforms without deconstructing them

You’re probably asking yourself ‘but what does Hell 2.0 bring?’

[previewyoutube=6s2o4UBdmeQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[u][b][h3]Here’s what’s new: [/h3][/b][/u]
* New in-game menu
* Sandbox changes into challenging Architect Mode
* A great variety of maps available in Architect Mode
* A surprise for completing all maps in Architect Mode
* Random Events
* New Hell development system
* Perks that allow you to unlock brand new stuff
* Legends are now called Infamous
* New purchase system for Wall of Infamy
* New buildings, platforms etc.
* End Goal
* New hellish music

Those are the main changes that come with our 2.0 update, although they hide much more… but we will leave it for you to explore, Boss!
We strongly believe, that this new version of Hell will provide long hours of fun filled with more dark humor for you!
If you played Hell right after the release and you felt like it wasn’t something you expected,
please give us another chance and check out our [u][b]Brand New Hell[/b][/u]! Hopefully it can change your mind ❤️

Enjoy your time in Hell! Please, don’t forget to torture your sinners! 


Woodland Games & Leonardo Interactive

[b][h2]Dear somber souls! [/h2][/b]
Let us start this devlog off with an apology, you – our dear players deserve.
We know that some translations have been problematic, and for that reason we would like to [b]sincerely apologize[/b]. We can only imagine how inconvenient it has been.
We are only humans who make mistakes, but what’s more important – we learn and do our best to fix them.
Although translation process is quite complicated and takes a while, we’re ready to inform you, that the newly improved translations are here! 

[b]What has changed? [/b]

Translation improvements for languages:
*French
*Italian
*German
*Japanese
*Korean
*Spanish
*Portuguese - Brazil
*Russian
*Simplified Chinese

As a team we are so lucky to have such amazing community members like you! All of the feedback you constantly provide for us keeps us motivated and gives us the opportunity to improve Hell Architect even more. 
It is our pleasure to do this for [b]YOU[/b]. Your support and loyalty are greatly appreciated and we’re extremely thankful for having you. We wouldn’t be here if it wasn’t for you!

We hope you’re having a [b]spooktacular[/b] time as the bloody and painful end of Spooktober is right around the corner. 
For the occasion of upcoming [b]HELLoween[/b], our demons have prepared a few nice treats that await you in their Hell.
We all know HELLoween is a special time of the year when sinners get to dress up and go trick or treating… well not this time and definitely not in HELL!  Things couldn’t be so heavenly here, don’t you think ⁉️
Following Lucifer’s rules and orders, we have to keep this place as dark and torturous as possible. Suffering is what keeps this place going eventually.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/950cb03765eca9c2101e178bf9d7d6eb21bd8656.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dear somber souls! [/b][/h2]

The spooky month of October has arrived! For that occassion we have brought quite a few treats for you. We know how hard you work in your Hell. Having a dark soul and using it every day to manage the darkest place that has ever existed is a tough job, especially when your lost souls carry some of the greatest sins on their weak little shoulders. 
To get the foretaste of upcoming [b][u]HELLoween[/u][/b] we’re giving you the tools to remind your sinners how dark your soul can get! Decorate your devilish empire with brand new set of Gothic decorations! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/7a659a4cebe3b54c4a71288475e1cd7668c07d22.png[/img]

Do your sinners always seem to feel like they don’t want to take part in your show called Infernal Nightmare ?! No problem! Place Thrift Shop Guillotine to remind your sinners, that they always need to keep their heads up! Their miserable life could always get worse right?! 

Are some of your sinners extremely insubordinate? Well well well... building the Skeleton Storage Cage would be a good idea in that case! This decoration would definitely let them know that nothing gets wasted in your Hell, and that they’re stuck here forever! 😈

Being in sinner's shoes you could think, that building the Altar to CEO’s Glory could earn Lucifer’s mercy, but don’t get your hopes up! Of course we recommend trying as It won’t hurt your sinners … at least not as much as the tortures they go through all the time in your burning world of suffering!

[u]You can find all of the new decorations in 'Decorations' -> 'Abandoned' section. [/u]

[b]There's also some small changes that we have implemented:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Quality of Life[/b] - you can now deconstruct many buildings at once by dragging your cursor over 
them

[*] [b]Quality of Life[/b] - you can now replace platforms without deconstructing them
[/list]
To top it all off we have prepared a surprise for you, our dear sinners! Hell Architect is now [b]30% off[/b] ‼️ It's a limited time offer so make sure you purchase your Hell by October 18th!

notes.title: BIG BIG Update is COMING 😈
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sinners, 
[/h3]

Today's devlog is very informative.

1. [u]Most of the bugs have been fixed[/u] - it was possible thanks to your feedback. [b]Thank you very much for the Saves you sent us - it made us able to fix particular problems much faster.
[/b]
[h3]If it was bugs that made Hell Architect a bad game for you, we encourage you to play again and perhaps change your review 😈😈😈[/h3]

We have not rested on laurels and we are still working on the game 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/8153540d4bd29e06c7060e79ab2db5dcff3f6cd4.png[/img]


[h2]2. We started working on an important UPDATE. What will be in it?[/h2]

[olist]
[*] [b]Random Events[/b] - you will have the opportunity to get something for free (of course it will not be that easy!), You will have to take a risk to get an unique item. In one sentence: it will be more difficult, but also more interesting! 😈
[*] [b]Perk system[/b] - there will be talents (almost like in the Got Talent program) that you can buy and use 😎
[*] [b]We are changing Sandbox to Hell Architect Mode[/b] - you will deal with adapting to use, uninhabited circles of hell, each map will save information about achievements on it, here you will find events and perks. Shortly: we will add a goal to make the gameplay more attractive 🔥
[*] [b]We are changing the main menu[/b] 🥳
[*] [b]MAC version will be available[/b] 🍏
[*] Mysterious [b]new legends[/b] will come 👑
[*] New hellish music for your souls 🎷
[*] And finally: the [b]rebalancing of costs[/b] 🤑
[/olist]

[h3]Is that all?[/h3]

No!

You can also expect [b]new decorations[/b] soon, thanks to which decorating hell has never been so cute 😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/0815c2a2632a1fda72d94f9d6bc328f364868e8b.png[/img]

[h3][u]The most important thing: when will this UPDATE be available?[/u][/h3]

We do not want to promise that in just a week. Having learned from our mistakes, we want to put these new mechanics to a very solid test. [b]Only when we are sure that everything is actually working we will add this Update. Expect it later this year![/b]


[h3]What about translations?[/h3]
[b]We are verifying them again, so we will update them soon - we will inform you about it.[/b]

This is not the end of surprises, but we can't reveal everything 🔥🔥🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/d83f527876e4666ba8b1eba1796c000cd1530d31.png[/img]
[h1]
So the winner is...[/h1]

🔥
🔥
🔥
🔥
🔥
🔥

[h2]First place 😈😈😈[/h2]

[b]Granny's Place[/b]
The torture machine is about the size of the Dentist's Chair. It's a picture of peace and tranquility with a lovable elder woman sitting on a rocking chair, knitting something or just idle. Her hands should not be visible at this moment. Her place can be decorated with floral patterned wallpaper, a small table with (very old) candy or cookies or stuff of the Biedermeier epoch. The left part of the machine is an open space where the sinner would stand. Once a sinner is assigned to this machine, Granny will leave the rocking chair, making exclamations as "My oh my! You've grown so much!" or "How thin you got!" and step towards the sinner. Her hands will become visible, a pair of frightening crustacean claws, which will mercilessly pinch and stretch out the sinner's cheeks.
Alternatively, she can grab some of the (very old) candy/cookies and stuff them into the sinner's mouth, increasing the food bar and decreasing the thirst bar.

[h2]Second place 😈😈😈[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/0a0cc88262f73ee2ad6bfb5f9bf163240489e26c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/d0291ee2a7c458b616709256b45023ca9d1760e4.png[/img][/url]
